en: eSIM for Thailand — data plans in US dollars | Magic eSIM
target: eSIM para Tailandia: planes de datos en dólares | Magic eSIM
suggestion: eSIM para Tailandia: planes de datos en USD | Magic eSIM
explanation: «US dollars» became plain «dólares»; for a Latin-American audience several currencies are called «dólares» or use «$», so the currency is less exact than the English. «USD» (do-not-translate, the site's price format) restores it and keeps the title under 60 characters.

«solo» before the verb can read as «they only cover (do nothing else)»; placing it before «Tailandia» scopes it to the country, as the English «Thailand only» does, and contrasts cleanly with the regional note («junto con otros países»).
